name: stuck-cursor
description:
A NinjaOne instance that stops advancing and answers every `after` with the same full page of five hundred devices. The walk's only exits are an empty page and a short page, and a repeated FULL page is neither, so this shape used to produce no exit at all: the script re-imported the same five hundred devices until the task timed out, with nothing in the log to say why.

The no-progress check is the working guard -- the max_pages ceiling behind it defaults to ten million records deep (20,000 pages of 500) and exists only so an adversarially rotating server still terminates. `after` is a keyset cursor carrying the id of the last row served, so a page whose last id repeats the previous one means the server ignored `after` or replayed a cached response, and the walk stops on the first repeat and says so, which is what log_contains pins.

Both pages carry a full five hundred rows because a shorter page would end the walk on its own and prove nothing, and they are byte-identical because that is exactly the failure being reproduced. The stop happens BEFORE the repeated page is reported, so the five hundred devices are imported once and asset_count pins that -- an earlier arrangement that reported first re-imported all five hundred and tripped the unique_ids invariant, which is precisely the duplicate work the guard exists to prevent. devices-detailed answers with a bare JSON array and reports no row total anywhere, so the message uses the no-total form rather than printing a denominator the script invented.

when_exhausted is `empty` ONLY as a terminator for a regression. With repeat_last an unguarded walk would run to the 20,000-page ceiling and fail this scenario by timing out rather than by failing an assertion; with the empty terminator it stops one request later and fails on request_count and the missing log line instead.

namespaced_ids is skipped for the reason recorded in happy and paged: the id is the bare NinjaOne device id with no tenant or instance scope.

log_contains: ninjaone: paging stopped after 2 pages (API returned the same cursor twice, retrieved 500 assets, total not reported)
